bg.$description: Raised surface color of the drawer.

bg-image.$description: Optional image layered over the drawer surface.

backdrop-filter.$description: Complete backdrop filter applied behind the drawer surface.

fg.$description: Foreground color on the drawer surface.

size.$description: Default inline size of a side sheet and block-size cap of a bottom sheet.

radius.$description: Radius of the corners on the inner edge of the drawer.

close-size.$description: Preferred size of the Close button before the density minimum.

handle-size.$description: Inline extent of the bottom-sheet handle.
